contract.title: Expanded target/source/absorber/environment scenario contract
inputs: Source histories and support from bass_cr; state-resolved emission/absorption from rec_bianchi; physical collisions/thermalclosure from BASS_HE
Geometry/frame/clock and density/environment from bass; named observable target and initial/boundary data from REI
equations: x_s=n_s/n_ref; default n_ref=n_ref0*a^(-3) is fixed-comoving bookkeeping normalization, independent of actual injected/transmuted populations
R_j/n_ref maps volumetric reaction rates to per-reference rates
Included eventset I(model) is selected explicitly; completeness quantified only overI(model)
dot(n_s)+3H*n_s=S_s; default dot(x_s)=S_s/n_ref. Evolving physical reference with source S_ref instead gives dot(x_s)=(S_s-x_s*S_ref)/n_ref

units.abundance: x_s=n_s/n_ref,dimensionless; default n_ref is a fixed-comoving bookkeeping reference, not evolving actual H/isotope/baryon density
units.event_source: events per reference nucleus per proper second
units.energy: source native eV with exact1eV=1.602176634e-19J;SIboundaryJ m^-3 s^-1
units.stress: J m^-3, full signed tensor sum before Frobenius norm

contract.domain: Finite declared cosmology/epoch/observer/environment and extensible supplied target catalog; all future nuclei/channels retained in programme inventory but not mandatory for every selected pilot
outputs: SCENARIO.json with targetcatalog,source/absorberIDs,domain,IC/BC,observable and exclusions with reasons
SOURCE_ABSORBER_MATRIX.json with leadproducer,consumer,units,qualification and externalreservoir perincludedchannel
COVERAGE_DELTA.json linking historical finite21to new selected isotope/anion/molecule states
acceptance: Conditional beta/molecular/stress dependencies follow actual selectedstate
Reference policy fixed-comoving versus evolving-physical explicitly bound; external injection and any S_ref correction retained in source/Jacobian
contract.claim_gate: Source-qualified selected scenario only; exact conservation does not establish physical rate correctness; globalphysicalcompletionnull
contract.independent_review: Fresh scientific authority reads actual source,units,modelselection,diff,raw and plots at claimed scope;not implementer
contract.pass_next_action: Bind one qualified event through REI-EXP-EVENT-CONSUMER; preserve unopened scenario variants

budget_status.reason: Future separateunit requiresfrozen measured allowance;no historicalbudgettransfer

pr_plan.base_policy: fresh current owner branch inspected immediately before additive publication;expectedSHA forcefalse
pr_plan.review_scope: new chosen provider-to-consumer binding and changeddependencies only

reference_normalization_policy.default: N_ref is a fixed bookkeeping count in a comoving volume; n_ref(t)=n_ref0*a(t)^(-3). It is not the evolving actual hydrogen/isotope/baryon count when injection or transmutation occurs.
reference_normalization_policy.source_equation: For physical species density dot(n_s)+3H*n_s=S_s, x_s=n_s/n_ref gives dot(x_s)=S_s/n_ref under the default fixed comoving reference. External injection belongs to S_s and is not absorbed into the reference.
reference_normalization_policy.changing_physical_reference: If a scenario explicitly selects an evolving physical reference, use dot(x_s)=dot(n_s)/n_ref-x_s*dot(n_ref)/n_ref. With dot(n_ref)+3H*n_ref=S_ref this becomes dot(x_s)=(S_s-x_s*S_ref)/n_ref; bind S_ref and its derivative explicitly.
reference_normalization_policy.reference_identity: Record n_ref0,scale-factor normalization,comoving volume convention and selected reference policy in SCENARIO and all consumer bindings.
